review_evidence: Reviewed the complete 388-primary-file LeanCert unit by source inventory and declaration scan. It contains certified interval, dyadic, transcendental, optimization, root-finding and analytic-number-theory developments together with their correctness theorems.

The hydrated source contains 5,425 definition/theorem/lemma/structure/class/instance-style declarations; representative engine modules pair executable certified procedures with formal correctness statements.
Benchmark and API files are interwoven with reusable certified interfaces and theorem-bearing components, so no content-level lossless hard-exclusion class was established for this unit.
summary: Reviewed LeanCert as a large theorem-bearing certified-analysis and numerical-verification development; the complete primary unit remains retained.
